_meta.author: Claude (rephrased from the 'description' and subflow names of abcd/data/guidelines.json)
_meta.style: 'The customer ...' sentences. Flow level only (10 flows). Subflow-level conditions are not used in v1: scenario subflow labels (96) do not match guideline subflow names (55) and need a manual mapping.
_meta.notes: Source guideline descriptions: product_defect='refunds and returns'; order_issue='get status of an order or change an order, possibly shipping'; account_access='username, password, and two-factor authentication'; troubleshoot_site='website slow, search not working, credit card, cart not updating'; manage_account='subscription service added or removed, change profile info'; purchase_dispute='bad price, out of stock, promo codes, billing'; shipping_issue='check our update a shipment of an item'; subscription_inquiry='billing and updates of the premium subscription service'; single_item_query='FAQ questions about jeans, boots, shirt or sweater'; storewide_query='FAQ questions about pricing, timing, membership or features'.

product_defect.description: The customer wants a refund or return, or asks about a refund, because a product has a problem such as a stain or the wrong color or size.

order_issue.description: The customer wants to check the status of an order or change an order, for example upgrade, downgrade, add to or cancel it.

account_access.description: The customer cannot access their account, for example a forgotten username or password or a two-factor authentication reset.

troubleshoot_site.description: The customer has a problem using the website, such as it being slow, search not working, a credit card being rejected or the cart not updating.

manage_account.description: The customer wants to manage their account, such as checking added or removed services or changing their address, name, phone number or payment method.

purchase_dispute.description: The customer disputes a purchase, for example a wrong price, an out-of-stock item, an invalid or expired promo code or incorrect billing.

shipping_issue.description: The customer asks about the shipment of an item, such as its status, changing the shipping, a missing item or the shipping cost.

subscription_inquiry.description: The customer asks about billing or updates of their premium subscription, such as the status, amount due, due date, paying, extending or disputing a bill.

single_item_query.description: The customer has a general question about a specific product such as jeans, boots, a shirt or a jacket.

storewide_query.description: The customer has a general question about the store such as pricing, opening times, membership or policies.
